t: A classroom Arduino kit with a breadboard, loose parts and a printed guide.
steps: Buy the kit from SparkFun, DigiKey, RobotShop or The Pi Hut.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Install the CH340 USB driver and test it before class.
Plug in the RedBoard and pick Arduino Uno as the board.
Download the kit sketches from the SIK-Guide-Code collection.
Wire Circuit 1A from the printed guide and blink your first LED.
Work through the five projects at your own pace.
Finish with the autonomous rover project.
meta: Wild Open. From $15.37. A few stores.
